author: John Muchovej
releaseNotes: Parameters as preferences (the device is the source of truth: refresh reads them, Save writes only what you changed, Configure writes none) and group bindings for switch-plus-bulbs units (bindGroup, unbindGroup, readBindings). Configure installs the hub reporting bindings. After selecting the driver: Save Preferences once, then Refresh. Validated on a VZM31-SN with two Hue bulbs, including with the hub powered off. Scene buttons and LED effects are not yet implemented.
